title: Format-Specific Features
description: Features specific to this content format, proposed by AI and confirmed by human.

features.name: plot_twist_strength
features.description: The intensity and surprise factor of the plot twist or revelation.

features.name: presenter_combination
features.description: The combination of presenters used in the video.

features.name: subject_type
features.description: The type of subject discussed in the video.

features.name: relatability_score
features.description: How relatable the story is to social media and marketing professionals.

features.name: educational_entertainment_balance
features.description: The balance between educational content and entertainment.

features.name: hook_strength
features.description: The effectiveness of the hook in capturing attention in the first few seconds.

features.name: use_of_specific_numbers
features.description: Presence of specific numbers, revenue figures, or growth stats in the video.

features.name: narrative_complexity
features.description: The complexity of the narrative structure.

features.name: tone_of_voice
features.description: The tone of voice used by the presenters.

features.name: pop_culture_focus
features.description: Whether the topic is focused more on pop culture or business.

features.name: call_to_action_quality
features.description: Effectiveness and clarity of the call to action.

features.name: cultural_relevance
features.description: Relevance of the topic to current cultural trends.

features.name: audience_familiarity_with_subject
features.description: How well-known the subject is to the audience.

features.name: presenter_energy_level
features.description: The energy level of the presenters during the video.

features.name: visual_relevance
features.description: Relevance of visual elements to the story being told.
